description: Collaborative Research: Frame-Spine System with Force-Limiting Connections for Low-Damage Seismic Resilient Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Larry Fahnestock, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). This project is developing a new structural system to protect buildings, their contents, and occupants during large earthquakes and will enable immediate post-earthquake occupancy. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Frame-Spine System, Force-Limiting Connections, Low-Damage Seismic Resilient Buildings. Published 2025-03-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
